purpose: Compare forward and native-reopen report declarations for body, named-group, and feature persistence on the host.
trigger: A forward report and a separately captured native-reopen report are available and persistence differences must be checked before visual acceptance.

inputs.name: forward_report_path
inputs.description: Path to the forward-run structured report.

inputs.name: reopened_report_path
inputs.description: Path to the structured report captured after native reopen.

inputs.name: bbox_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Allowed absolute difference for bounding-box coordinates; defaults to 1e-9 mm.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Allowed absolute difference for body volumes; defaults to 1e-9 mm3.

inputs.name: feature_tolerance
inputs.description: Allowed absolute difference for feature measurements; defaults to 1e-9 in the declared units.

preconditions: forward_report_path and reopened_report_path identify readable UTF-8 structured report JSON files and resolve to distinct files.
The two reports are intended to describe the same case and target; their declared statuses and evidence states remain subject to validation.
Each tolerance, when supplied, is finite and non-negative.

outputs.name: comparison_result
outputs.description: Structured host comparison result with equality flags, status, and machine-readable issues.

postconditions: comparison_result is emitted with status passed or failed and an inspectable issue list.
A passed result means both reports are structurally valid and passed, describe the same case and target, declare native_save/native_reopen as passed, and match within the requested tolerances.
A failed result does not diagnose a SpaceClaim model independently; it reports differences in the supplied declarations.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer; compares structured report JSON without launching SpaceClaim or reopening a document.
implementation.notes: The comparator treats forward and reopen reports as input declarations and does not independently observe either run.

ambiguity_checks: No geometry objects are selected; body, named-group, and feature names are compared as declared in the reports.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation has no geometry topology effect.

failure_modes.condition: forward_report_path and reopened_report_path resolve to the same file.
failure_modes.detection: Compare canonical real paths before loading either report.
failure_modes.safe_state: Comparison status is failed and no native persistence conclusion is made.

failure_modes.condition: The forward report cannot be read, is structurally invalid, or does not have status passed.
failure_modes.detection: Run the shared report structure validator and require forward status passed before comparison.
failure_modes.safe_state: No persistence conclusion is made and comparison status is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The reopened report cannot be read, is structurally invalid, or does not have status passed.
failure_modes.detection: Run the shared report structure validator and require reopened status passed before comparison.
failure_modes.safe_state: No persistence conclusion is made and comparison status is failed.

failure_modes.condition: A requested tolerance is negative, non-finite, or otherwise invalid.
failure_modes.detection: Validate all tolerance values before reading report fields.
failure_modes.safe_state: No comparison is accepted and status is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The forward report does not declare native_save passed or the reopened report does not declare native_reopen passed.
failure_modes.detection: Check the corresponding evidence-layer states before comparing geometry declarations.
failure_modes.safe_state: The result is failed and no native persistence claim is promoted.

failure_modes.condition: Case/target, body bounds or volumes, named-group membership, or feature values differ beyond tolerance.
failure_modes.detection: Compare each declared name and numeric field and emit a stable mismatch issue.
failure_modes.safe_state: The result is failed; preserve both input reports for investigation.

recovery.action: Capture the native-reopen report as a distinct artifact, then rerun the comparison.
Repair or regenerate the forward report and rerun the comparison.
Repair or regenerate the reopened report and rerun the comparison.
Supply finite non-negative tolerances and rerun without modifying either report.
Obtain the required native save/reopen evidence through the controlled workflow, then rerun this host comparison.
Investigate the first reported difference and rerun with corrected, provenance-preserving reports or an explicitly reviewed tolerance.

validation.check: Input report structure and status gates
validation.method: Run repository compare_runtime_reports host tests with valid, failed, and malformed forward/reopen reports.
validation.expected: Both reports must be structurally valid and passed before persistence fields are compared.

validation.method: Run repository compare_runtime_reports host tests covering body bounds/volumes, named groups, features, native-save/reopen states, and tolerance errors.
validation.expected: Equal declarations pass; differences and invalid gates return failed with a stable issue and no exception.

validation.check: Forward and native-reopen inputs are distinct
validation.method: Run the command-line host test with both report arguments resolving to the same file.
validation.expected: Comparison fails with same_report_path before interpreting report declarations.

evidence_refs.notes: Public contract review record; no private model or host path is included.

design_only.notes: The contract is case-neutral and limited to host comparison of declared reports.

evidence_refs.notes: Nine repository unit tests passed for this exact tool and contract revision.

host_checked.notes: Host report comparison checks only; no SpaceClaim process was launched.

geometry_measurements.notes: Declared measurements are compared but not independently measured.

native_save.notes: The comparator does not save a native document.

native_reopen.notes: The comparator does not reopen a native document.

visual_review.notes: No viewport or image is reviewed.

evidence_level.notes: Formal evidence stops at design_only and host_checked for this host-only operation.
